## TASK-028 - Adopt the exact root packages and configuration

Review source and destination copies, install the new root ontology package/contracts/locked core and selected updated initializer package, specialize sys4ai-depot ontology configuration and record an exact adoption receipt.

### Risks

- Preserve unrelated bytes and stop on stale inputs or a scope conflict.

### Acceptance criteria

- Root identity/namespace, selected core versions and publication binding are local and current; only the reviewed ontology and initializer package boundary changes.
- Existing memory/learning packages, memory config/records, governing authority hashes, roles, licenses and registry remain intact.
- Root adoption records source/destination file hashes and recovery/preservation results; retired components remain absent.
- Repository initializer-parity assertions consume the new before/after adoption receipt as the successor to prior licensing/memory/learning receipts, preserving all historical receipts and checking current source/installed equality.

### Planned verification

- Compare exact source/installed package inventories, validate root configuration and inspect the adoption receipt.
- Run the installed initializer contract tests and installed ontology read-only health/validate routes; compare protected baseline hashes.
